visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shrink the Prefix Instead of Comparing Letters
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops compare the words letter by letter with a flag and a break. Shrink a candidate prefix with indexOf instead, inside a commonPrefix function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: indexOf does the comparison and the length handling, so the index arithmetic and the flag disappear, and the logic becomes a reusable function.
